result:
The decisive mistake was made by API_Expert at Step 8. It reused the single-page logic (`per_page=100`, no pagination) and took `min(created_at)` over only that page. The GitHub issues endpoint returns newest-first, so the "oldest" issue it found was just the oldest of the 100 most recent labeled issues, not the oldest overall. That produced the wrong date, 08/27/20, instead of 04/15/18. The same flaw was present in Step 2, but it was masked there because the wrong label name returned no results.

AGENT: API_Expert
STEP: 8
